record.question: Under Section 521 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, when a person liable to be tried by a Court-martial is brought before a Magistrate and charged with an offence, the Magistrate may:
options: Proceed with the trial in all cases.
Release the accused without any inquiry.
Deliver the person, together with a statement of the offence, to the commanding officer for trial by Court-martial.
Transfer the case only to the Sessions Court.
